description: Match an ingredient (and optional dose) against Reg. 432/2012 authorised claims and the SANCO/11074/2013 botanical list via C.L.A.I.M.S. (FOODLAW.ai). Botanical claims are always returned as regulatory_status "on_hold" (not authorised). Usage limit: 2000 calls per user per day (10000 for shared Google network addresses).
name: search_claims_foodlaw
title: Match health claims with C.L.A.I.M.S.
